subtitle: DGAC Office — Denial of written documentation / intermediary role
location: Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport (SCL), Santiago, Chile — DGAC Office
classification: Attorney Work Product — Privileged and Confidential

participants.role: DGAC Official — defensive, uses deflection loop
DGAC Official — insistent on procedure, acknowledges false accusation

cluster_A_DGAC_intermediary_role.summary: DGAC officials repeatedly state they act only as intermediaries: they receive the captain's request for disembarkation, take the passenger, and hand him to PDI. They do not investigate the underlying reason; legitimacy is 'tema de la compañía' / commercial matter of the airline.

cluster_B_deflection_loop.summary: Ortiz and officials repeatedly redirect to the airline: 'todo eso tiene que hablar con la línea aérea.' They use '¿cierto?' to force agreement and cut Leandro off mid-sentence.

cluster_C_false_accusation_acknowledged.summary: CRITICAL: DGAC Official acknowledges: 'una acusación falsa.' PDI dismissal confirmed: 'desestimaron todo lo que dijo el caballero.' Official admits 'Tampoco me explico' regarding LATAM's persistence.

cluster_D_document_exists_not_for_passen.summary: Official confirms disembarkation document exists but is internal: 'para el capital y para la DGAC.' Leandro cites Ley 20.831; officials acknowledge but withhold document.

cluster_E_ping_pong_and_state.summary: Leandro describes institutional ping-pong (PDI → LATAM → PDI). Physical state documented: medication, hunger, extreme stress, no flight. Officials acknowledge situation is unpleasant but offer no resolution.

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: DGAC acts purely as intermediary on captain's request; does not verify legitimacy: 'tema de la compañía.'
False accusation acknowledged on tape: 'una acusación falsa.'
PDI dismissal confirmed: 'desestimaron todo lo que dijo el caballero.'
Document exists but is 'para el capital y para la DGAC' — not for passenger.
Ping-pong confirmed: PDI told Leandro to ask LATAM; LATAM told him to ask PDI.
'Tampoco me explico' — institutional incomprehension at LATAM's persistence.
Communication tactics documented: defensiveness ('Responsable de que?'), victimization ('no me grites'), condescension ('Escucha que le está explicando caballero').
